episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'separation season' and the importance of maintaining momentum during slower months in real estate. He emphasizes the need for agents to focus on fundamentals and consistency, even when immediate results aren't visible. The episode provides actionable strategies for lead generation, client management, and personal growth to ensure long-term success.
